# Intangible Asset Valuation Engine

> Open-source (MIT) Python library and MCP server implementing 124+ formulas from the Intangible Asset Valuation textbook by Simon Mak, William Yuen, Paul Wu and Wayne Hu (Valuation in Practice Series, Ascent Partners). 14 read-only, deterministic MCP tools support auditable ASC 805 / IFRS 3 / IFRS 13 work: relief from royalty, MPEEM, cost, market and income approaches, purchase price allocation, goodwill impairment, IP, technology, customer and workforce assets, royalty-rate analysis, Monte Carlo and decision trees.

## Connect

- Hosted MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://intangible-valuation.simonmak.com/api/mcp
- Local stdio server: `uvx --from intangible-valuation intangible-valuation-mcp` or `pip install 'intangible-valuation[mcp]' && intangible-valuation-mcp`
- Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.simonplmak-cloud/intangible-valuation`
- Glama listing: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/simonplmak-cloud/intangible-valuation
- Context7 library ID: `/simonplmak-cloud/intangible-valuation`

## MCP tools

All tools are deterministic calculators: read-only, no external data. Supply every input explicitly.

- `valuation_time_value`: discounting and compounding, annuities and perpetuities, terminal value (Gordon growth or exit multiple)
- `valuation_discount_rate`: build-up, CAPM, WACC, tax-amortization benefit, control premium, Finnerty DLOM, country-risk adjustment
- `valuation_cost_approach`: depreciated reproduction and replacement cost, net of obsolescence
- `valuation_market_approach`: comparable transaction multiples and royalty capitalization
- `valuation_income_methods`: relief from royalty, multi- and single-period excess earnings (MPEEM), incremental cash flow, contributory asset charges
- `valuation_ip`, `valuation_technology`, `valuation_customer`, `valuation_human_capital`: asset-class-specific methods
- `valuation_goodwill_ppa`: purchase price allocation and goodwill
- `valuation_impairment`: goodwill and intangible impairment testing
- `valuation_royalty_analysis`: royalty-rate benchmarks by IP type and industry, deal-factor adjustments, 25% rule
- `valuation_simulation`: Monte Carlo valuation and sensitivity ranking, decision trees, one-at-a-time sensitivity
- `valuation_compliance`: CUP arm's-length range for transfer pricing, patent infringement damages
